subject: mathematics
concept: Naming halves and quarters using everyday words before symbols
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student splits an object in half, then in quarters, naming each result aloud
exercise.pictorial: Student matches shaded shapes to the words 'half' and 'quarter'
exercise.abstract: Student writes 'half' or 'quarter' under the correct shaded image

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
